problem.name: Cycle detection
problem.statement_latex: Given an undirected graph $G=(V,E)$, decide whether it contains a cycle. Two input models are considered: an adjacency matrix and neighbor arrays with maximum degree $d_{\max}$.
problem.statement_text: Given an undirected graph $G=(V,E)$, decide whether it contains a cycle. Two input models are considered: an adjacency matrix and neighbor arrays with maximum degree $d_{\max}$.

quantum.headline_latex: $\widetilde O(n^{3/2})$ matrix-query time, or $\widetilde O(n\sqrt{d_{\max}})$ neighbor-array time, using $O(\log n)$ work qubits in the Cade--Montanaro--Belovs construction.
quantum.headline_text: $\widetilde O(n^{3/2})$ matrix-query time, or $\widetilde O(n\sqrt{d_{\max}})$ neighbor-array time, using $O(\log n)$ work qubits in the Cade–Montanaro–Belovs construction.
